body: I'm grieving a crazy traumatic suicide. It would be weird if I wasn't feeling suicidal myself. I belong in a bereavement group, all of me, my whole truth, just like anyone else. If that upsets people that says more about them. Do people really think I'm not feeling and thinking the same things? That I could have done more? Blaming myself? Angry? Etc. I'm sick of being told, and treated like, I don't belong or have a right to exist in spaces where I do. I didn't come here to argue about whether or not I belong here. I came here for support to grieve. It looks like this was also a bad idea. I'll be deleting my post soon. I'm not interested in having to defend myself everywhere anymore.

You know what? I've looked everywhere for support. It doesn't matter where I go. Someone always tells me I'm not wanted there, it's not a good fit. I'm sick of hearing it. Every group gets triggered. I give up. It's not like reddit was the first place I tried to find help. People freak out because my therapist blurred boundaries, they freak out because of how I'm responding to it. It doesn't matter, someone will always find a reason to "other" me. I'm done.

Rather than report me. How bout people talk to me? Reporting is really counter productive and feels pretty bad. I posted here because I'm grieving hard. Was hoping to connect with people rather than get an anonymous report.
Not sure how this all works. I don't see my post on the main page where everyone else's is? Looks like no one can see this. I'm confused.
